description: Analyze domain infrastructure by performing comprehensive DNS, WHOIS, and security audits. Identify technology stacks, track SSL validity, and verify email security configurations to ensure optimal web presence. Monitor global DNS propagation and discover subdomains to gain a complete picture of any domain's health and history.

rawRecord.description: Analyze domain infrastructure by performing comprehensive DNS, WHOIS, and security audits. detail.description: Analyze domain infrastructure by performing comprehensive DNS, WHOIS, and security audits. Identify technology stacks, track SSL validity, and verify email security configurations to ensure optimal web presence. Monitor global DNS propagation and discover subdomains to gain a complete picture of any domain's health and history.

timeout.description: Maximum time in milliseconds for each tool request. Default is 30000 (30 seconds).

tools.name: domain_report
tools.description: Get a complete domain intelligence report. Runs ALL checks at once: DNS, WHOIS, email security, SSL, HTTP headers, tech stack detection, and domain age. This is the recommended starting tool.

tools.name: dns_lookup
tools.description: Look up DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, or ALL) for any domain.

domain.description: Domain name to look up (e.g. example.com)

record_type.description: DNS record type to query. Use ALL to fetch every type.

tools.name: whois_lookup
tools.description: Get WHOIS registration data for a domain including registrar, creation/expiry dates, and days remaining.

domain.description: Domain name to look up (e.g. example.com)

tools.name: domain_available
tools.description: Check whether a domain is available for registration. Suggests alternative TLDs if the domain is taken.

tools.name: email_config_check
tools.description: Audit email security configuration: MX, SPF, DKIM (common selectors), and DMARC records. Returns a letter grade A–F.

tools.name: ssl_check
tools.description: Check SSL/TLS certificate details for a domain: issuer, validity dates, days remaining, protocol, and fingerprint.

domain.description: Domain or hostname to check (e.g. example.com)

tools.name: reverse_dns
tools.description: Reverse DNS lookup — convert an IP address to its hostname(s), or find the IP behind a domain and do reverse lookup.

target.description: IP address or domain name (e.g. 8.8.8.8 or example.com)

tools.name: dns_propagation
tools.description: Check if DNS has propagated by querying 8 public resolvers worldwide (Google, Cloudflare, OpenDNS, Quad9, etc.).

tools.name: subdomain_finder
tools.description: Discover common subdomains for a domain by checking ~80 common subdomain prefixes.

domain.description: Domain to scan for subdomains (e.g. example.com)

tools.name: http_headers_check
tools.description: Audit HTTP security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, etc.) and give a letter grade A–F.

domain.description: Domain or URL to check (e.g. example.com)

tools.name: redirect_chain
tools.description: Trace the full redirect chain for a URL. Shows every redirect hop, status code, and final destination.

tools.name: tech_stack_detect
tools.description: Detect the technology stack of a website: web server, CDN, framework, CMS, analytics, and more.

tools.name: domain_age
tools.description: Calculate the exact age of a domain and show its registration timeline.

domain.description: Domain to check age of (e.g. example.com)

tools.name: dns_compare
tools.description: Compare DNS records of two domains side by side. Useful for comparing setups or verifying migration.

tools.name: port_check
tools.description: Check if common network ports are open on a domain. Useful for verifying services are running.

ports.description: Comma-separated port numbers or 'common' for standard web/mail/ssh ports

domain.description: Domain or IP to scan (e.g. example.com)
